newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields closed unchanged on Thursday from the previous session's closing levels, but off the day's highs.
"The U.S. yields have risen quite a bit, but the Swedish market is doing well anyway. There have not been any major portfolio shifts," one dealer said.
Six-month T-bill rates were flat at 5.05 percent, as were the nine-year bond yields which closed at 8.17 percent.
The spread between German and Swedish longer yields steepened three basis point to 181 as the market was expecting the Riksbank to cut its key repo rate on Tuesday.
The repo rate is currently set at 5.25 percent.
The market was looking for U.S. August jobs data due on Friday at 1030 GMT. This was expected to overshadow Swedish August unemployment data, due at 1100 GMT.
Swedish unemployment is expected to fall to 8.6 percent from 8.8 percent in July.
